prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Goal: One production reference for a NEW single game model: a monumental roofless mine kiln frame surrounding a square excavation, viewed from above enough to clearly see the empty center.
Subject: A square masonry and timber enclosure, outside footprint 24 by 24 metres, inner completely EMPTY square opening 20 by 20 metres. Four chunky square masonry corner piers built from rough grey-brown rectangular stone blocks. Rear two piers rise 9 metres and carry one broad tall stone arch across the REAR EDGE ONLY. Front corner piers are 4 metres high with squared timber caps. Low stone side parapets and stout horizontal rough oak lintels with diagonal braces connect front to rear along both SIDE EDGES only. No beam crosses the central hole. Front edge has two short low stone wall returns leaving a wide 6 metre central entrance open down to ground level. Small iron lanterns mounted on front piers. One coherent connected ruin-like mine structure.
Materials: Coarse chunky square rough stone blocks, warm brown sawn oak timbers, restrained black iron fasteners. Minecraft-inspired craft and block proportions, visibly weathered stone, matte. Subtle bevels, no rounded boulder piles, no teal roofs, no glossy surfaces.
Composition: Entire square enclosure visible on a plain light grey studio background, three-quarter bird eye view from the FRONT, looking down approximately 40 degrees. The central courtyard is completely EMPTY, background visible through it. Clear front entry, two side edges recede to the tall rear arch. The rear arch is a vertical gable, not a roof over the courtyard.
Constraints: NO FLOOR anywhere, NO central pedestal, NO soil inside, NO roof covering the middle, no chimney in center, no machinery in center, no characters, no scenery, no text, no logos. The empty square opening occupies at least 80 percent of footprint width. Architecture lives only around its narrow perimeter. This is one isolated model reference, not a complete landscape.
